patch_description: Keep four relocated particles and replace displacement-driven expansion with a small diameter-dependent adjustment around 1.21875. The measured constant radius 1.25 achieved lower mean error than the current expansion rule, motivating a smaller radius range. Test whether modestly increasing radius for broader swarms helps: the multiplier stays within [1.2109375, 1.2265625]. This is an untested hypothesis; improved mean error or useful state dependence requires measured comparison.
